m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: There! That must be the entrance to the Zruvan Grotto. I heard it was more difficult to find, but I suppose we shouldn't complain.
By all that's subjected to the ravages of Time, I never imagined... I heard legends, but to behold this being... I am truly humbled.
It is your place to consult the Chronocle, Wizard. I will stand aside. I am merely honored to witness this event.
I understand what drove you to defy my servants, but this was unnecessary. You have now been exposed to knowledge unfit for any mortal.
Judge me not for what you learned. If I chose otherwise, there would be no Spiral. Doomed as it may be, it has still been a glorious ride.
For the Moment, I've set Time aright again. To reset the Sands, you must reclaim the Chronoshards and the Eye of History from the Chronoverge.
But make no mistake about my intentions - the priority now is to destroy Spider for once and all, whatever the cost. Do not fail me in this.
I believe my mind has just been blown, and not for the first time today. I'll give you a moment to yourself. Meet me back in Caterwaul Canyons.
I won't pretend to understand everything that's going on here, or even all of what's at stake. But we do have a chance to save the Spiral.
What I found instead was this young Qhat, who has disturbing revelations about what's underway at the Chronoverge.
Indeed. Wizard, perhaps you remember me from Xerxes' Tomb? After we parted, I returned to the Chronoverge, but soon learned a terrible truth.
Chronomaster Devlin and the others are all part of some group known as the Cabal. They've seized control and reversed the Sands of Time.
Even if were I able to get back into the Chronoverge and defeat them, I wouldn't have the foggiest notion of how to set things aright again.
There may yet be a way. At the Spiral's Dawn, it's said Grandmother Raven safeguarded the Secrets of Time with a being known as the Chronocle.
If you could consult this Chronocle... but I don't know where, only that it's believed to be inside the Timeless Tower.
The Timeless Tower? That's in the Zruvan Grotto! It's forbidden, but... Wizard, quickly, to Caterwaul Canyons! I'll show you the way.
I don't know if this is coincidence or fate, but we must seize the moment. Listen carefully to the Chronocle, Wizard.
